chunks.question: Are AeroSports jump socks required?
chunks.answer: Yes, AeroSports socks are required at all locations. Jump socks are available for $3.99 + tax. They are reusable, so keep yours for future visits!

chunks.question: Is there a weight limit for the trampolines?
chunks.answer: Our trampolines have a 300-pound weight limit.

chunks.question: Are waivers required? Can they be filled out online?
chunks.answer: Waivers are required for every guest to the park including non-jumpers. You can fill out the waiver online before you arrive to reduce check-in time. Children under 18 must have the waiver signed by a parent or legal guardian.

chunks.question: Can I leave my child(ren) unattended?
chunks.answer: Children under 12 cannot be dropped off without an adult present. While every child under 18 needs a parent or legal guardian to sign the waiver, please ensure all children understand the park rules before dropping them off.

chunks.question: Do spectators have to pay to watch jumpers?
chunks.answer: Non-jumpers are never charged admission. Only jumpers pay for general admission.

chunks.question: Do you have food available to purchase?
chunks.answer: Yes! We have a fully stocked Snack Shack serving delicious treats.

chunks.question: What days are the least busy?
chunks.answer: Weekends are our busiest days. Mondays and Tuesdays are usually less busy.

chunks.question: Can my small child come to the park?
chunks.answer: As long as the child can walk, they can jump!

chunks.question: Do you sell gift cards?
chunks.answer: Yes! Purchase a physical gift card at the park or buy one online.

chunks.question: Do jump cards expire?
chunks.answer: No, our jump cards never expire and can be used by different jumpers.

chunks.question: When are refunds processed?
chunks.answer: Refunds take 3-5 business days to reflect in your bank account.

chunks.question: Do you have single and dual karts?
chunks.answer: Yes! We have a mini track for kids as young as 3, and a big track with both single and dual rider karts.

chunks.question: What's the minimum height requirement for go karting?
chunks.answer: Mini Track: 36 inches. Main Track (driver): 54 inches. Dual Kart (passenger): 36 inches.

chunks.question: Do I need a jump pass for go karting?
chunks.answer: No! You can buy standalone go karting races without a jump pass.

chunks.question: Do both driver and passenger need a race pass?
chunks.answer: Yes, every customer participating in go karting needs a valid race pass.

chunks.question: Are AeroSports socks required for go karting?
chunks.answer: Closed-toed shoes are required on the track. AeroSports socks are required for all other attractions.

chunks.question: Can I book a specific time slot for go karting?
chunks.answer: No. Races operate on a first-come, first-served basis. Check in upon arrival, then head to the track.

chunks.question: What is Glow?
chunks.answer: At Scarborough, we have glow in the dark at ALL times! The main arena features laser lights and LED lights for an amazing experience.

chunks.question: How do I book a group event?
chunks.answer: Book through our website or by phone. A 25% deposit is required. Confirm within the holding period to avoid losing your reservation.

chunks.question: Is a jumpers list required?
chunks.answer: Yes, provide the jumpers list two weeks before the booking date so we can pre-check waivers and speed up check-in.

chunks.question: Is pricing the same for weekdays and weekends?
chunks.answer: Group jump pricing is the same for weekdays and weekends. Facility rental rates differ.

chunks.question: What's included in the group jump?
chunks.answer: Jump time and Aero socks are included. Add-on options available at extra cost.

chunks.question: What is the minimum number of jumpers?
chunks.answer: 15 jumpers minimum to qualify for group event pricing.

chunks.question: Are private rooms included with group events?
chunks.answer: Rooms are not included but can be rented for an additional cost.

chunks.question: What's included in the facility rental?
chunks.answer: Complimentary jump socks, exclusive facility access (up to 220 jumpers), all party rooms, tablecloths and cutlery. Unlimited go karting. Food/catering available at additional cost.

chunks.question: How do I prepare for my group event?
chunks.answer: Confirm booking and pay 25% deposit. Submit jumpers list two weeks before. Ensure all waivers signed in advance. Stay in touch with our team.

chunks.question: What is the cancellation or refund policy?
chunks.answer: Deposits are non-refundable. Rescheduling options may be available. Contact our team.

chunks.question: Are food and catering options available?
chunks.answer: Yes, food and catering can be arranged at additional cost.

chunks.question: What's the discount code for group events?
chunks.answer: Use code GROUPBOOKING25 for 25% off group rates for 15+ jumpers.

chunks.question: Is go karting included in group bookings?
chunks.answer: Yes! 1x go kart race per jumper for group bookings. Unlimited go karting for facility rentals.

chunks.question: How early should guests arrive?
chunks.answer: All guests should arrive 20 minutes before the scheduled jump time for check-in.

chunks.question: Are socks included in the party package?
chunks.answer: Sock inclusions vary by package. Premium: No. VIP: 50% off. Ultimate: FREE socks.

chunks.question: Can I invite additional jumpers beyond the minimum?
chunks.answer: Yes, additional jumpers can be added at the per-jumper price. Ensure total doesn't exceed room capacity.

chunks.question: What if I forget to pre-order add-ons?
chunks.answer: Add-ons can be ordered within 24 hours but will incur a $20 late ordering fee.

chunks.question: Are attractions exclusive to my party?
chunks.answer: No, attractions are shared with other patrons. Your party room is private.

chunks.question: Can I extend the jumping or party room time?
chunks.answer: Additional time may be available for purchase based on availability.

chunks.question: What if some guests don't show up?
chunks.answer: The minimum jumper count for your package is still charged. Additional fees for extra arrivals.

chunks.question: Can I request a specific party room?
chunks.answer: We try to accommodate but cannot guarantee — based on availability.

chunks.question: Is there an area for parents to wait?
chunks.answer: Yes, parents can relax in our viewing area or common spaces.

chunks.question: Can I bring outside decorations?
chunks.answer: Yes, as long as they comply with policies. No confetti, piñatas, or silly string. $40 cleaning charge if used.

chunks.question: What is the check-in process for party guests?
chunks.answer: Staff assists with check-in. Ensure waivers completed beforehand. Wristbands provided.

chunks.question: Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
chunks.answer: Yes, with advance notice. Contact us to discuss options.

chunks.question: What if my party runs late?
chunks.answer: Parties must follow scheduled time. Overages may result in additional fees.

chunks.question: Is the birthday child included in the jumper count?
chunks.answer: Yes, the birthday child counts toward the minimum.

chunks.question: Are party invitations provided?
chunks.answer: Digital invitations included in every package. Physical invitations: $0.75 each.

chunks.question: Can I bring themed props or costumes?
chunks.answer: Yes, as long as they are safe and suitable for jumping.

chunks.question: What if my child gets injured?
chunks.answer: Trained staff respond on-site. Parents notified immediately. Emergency protocols for serious injuries.

chunks.question: Can I tour the facility before booking?
chunks.answer: Yes! Contact us to arrange a visit.

chunks.question: Can I split the party cost?
chunks.answer: Yes, payments can be split. Let us know in advance.

chunks.question: Do you help with setup and cleanup?
chunks.answer: Yes, staff assists with setup and handles cleanup.

chunks.question: Are there options for non-jumpers?
chunks.answer: Non-jumpers can enjoy the party room and food but not attractions. Don't count toward minimum.

chunks.question: Can I book for twins or multiple children?
chunks.answer: Yes! Let us know in advance so we can customize the plans.

chunks.question: What is the cancellation/rescheduling policy?
chunks.answer: Reschedule within 1 year, no charge. Cancel 14+ days: store gift card. Within 14 days: no refund.

chunks.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my package?
chunks.answer: Must be 14+ days in advance, subject to availability.

chunks.question: Are there rewards for hosting multiple parties?
chunks.answer: Contact us about repeat booking discounts or rewards.

chunks.question: What's included in Aero Camp?
chunks.answer: Supervised trampoline activities, games, challenges, crafts, contests, and group activities.

chunks.question: Can I book individual days or must I book a full week?
chunks.answer: You can book individual days or a full week. Both pricing options available.

chunks.question: Is lunch included?
chunks.answer: Lunch is not included but can be added for $9.90/day. You can also send a packed lunch.

chunks.question: How do I register my child?
chunks.answer: Register online or call the park. Spots fill up quickly — early registration recommended.

chunks.question: What should my child bring?
chunks.answer: Comfortable activewear, packed lunch/snacks (if not buying lunch combo), refillable water bottle.

chunks.question: Is there supervision during camp?
chunks.answer: Yes, trained staff supervise at all times.

chunks.question: Can I add early drop-off or late pick-up last minute?
chunks.answer: Yes, typically can be added with short notice. Notify camp team ASAP.

chunks.question: What is the age requirement?
chunks.answer: Campers must be 4-12 years old.

chunks.question: Are waivers required for camp?
chunks.answer: Yes, signed waiver required before attending. Complete online or at the park.

chunks.question: When are PA Day Camps offered?
chunks.answer: Available on all PA days per Catholic and Public Elementary School Boards. Check website or call.

chunks.question: When is Summer Camp?
chunks.answer: Runs during specific summer weeks. Dates announced closer to start.

chunks.question: When is March Break Camp?
chunks.answer: During official March Break for all elementary and secondary students.

chunks.question: When is Winter Camp?
chunks.answer: During winter holiday period. Dates posted closer to season.

chunks.question: Can parents stay during camp?
chunks.answer: We encourage drop-off for a smooth experience. Let us know if your child needs settling-in support.

chunks.question: How are extended hours structured?
chunks.answer: Supervised free play or quiet activities. Early drop-off from 7:30 AM. Late pick-up past 6PM (prices vary).

chunks.question: Is there a lost and found?
chunks.answer: Yes. Please label all personal items.

chunks.question: Are electronic devices allowed?
chunks.answer: We recommend leaving them at home to avoid distractions or damage.

chunks.question: Are there rest periods during the day?
chunks.answer: Yes, short breaks for rest, snacks, and lunch. Quiet activities like crafts may be offered.

chunks.question: What if my child feels unwell?
chunks.answer: We notify you immediately. Trained staff handle minor first-aid. Provide emergency contacts at registration.

chunks.question: How are behavioral issues handled?
chunks.answer: Staff manage conflicts calmly. Parents informed if further action needed.

chunks.question: What is included in the lunch combo?
chunks.answer: Kid-friendly options: pizza, a drink, and a snack.

chunks.question: Can my child join if they miss the first day?
chunks.answer: Yes, late arrivals welcome if space available.

chunks.question: If my child is 3 years old, can they use the Premium pass, and how long does it last?
chunks.answer: Yes they can. Premium passes last for 1 hour 30  minutes.

chunks.question: What if I want to maximize jumping time for my kids—should I opt for the VIP pass or multiple Premium passes?
chunks.answer: You can get an ALL day pass that provides you 5 hours of jump time.

chunks.question: What attractions do you have in the park?
chunks.answer: We have trampoines, ninja warrior obstacle course, ninja maze, donut slide, 360 bike, Go Karting, dodgeball area in trampoline, rock walls, airbags.
